Open eyes. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.
Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and cereal. Close refrigerator. Take bowl. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting ready and packing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt and pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Place laptop inside. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Walk out.

Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Stand and wait. Check phone. See bus approach. Board bus. Swipe card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Look out window. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to workplace.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Walk to desk. Put bag down. Turn on computer. Check emails. Open patient files. Review patient charts. Walk to examination room. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Examine patient. Take notes. Remove gloves. Wash hands. Walk to desk. Update patient records. Attend meeting. Discuss patient cases. Return to desk. Answer phone.

Walk to break room. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch box. Close refrigerator. Open microwave. Place lunch box inside. Close microwave. Press start button. Wait. Open microwave. Take out lunch box. Open lunch box. Pick up fork. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Stand up. Throw away trash. Walk to restroom. Wash hands. Walk back to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to examination room. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Examine patient. Take notes. Remove gloves. Wash hands. Walk to desk. Update patient records. Answer phone. Talk to colleague. Walk to supply room. Pick up supplies. Return to desk. Organize supplies. Check emails. Attend meeting. Discuss patient cases. Return to desk. Write report.

Walk to bus stop. Stand and wait. Check phone. See bus approach. Board bus. Swipe card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Look out window. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to house. Open door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Rinse plate.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Drink. Watch TV. Put down drink. Watch TV.

Walk to bathroom. Pick up laundry basket. Open washing machine. Place clothes inside. Close washing machine. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent. Close drawer. Press start button. Wait. Open washing machine. Take out clothes. Place clothes in dryer. Close dryer. Press start button. Wait. Open dryer. Take out clothes. Fold clothes. Place clothes in basket.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on shower. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wash body. Wash hair. Rinse. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Put on pajamas. Turn off shower.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on lamp. Pick up book. Read. Put down book. Turn off lamp. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain still with eyes closed. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Remain still with eyes closed. Sleep.
